summary_text: Fiscal Q4 2026 earnings reported May 6 - net income +49% YoY to $313M (from $210M), revenue +20% to $1.49B (from $1.24B). Data center royalty revenue more than doubled YoY. AGI CPU customer demand >$2B across FY27-FY28 (vs $1B six weeks earlier at launch). Nvidia CFO: aims to be 'world's leading CPU supplier' with Arm-based Vera CPU opening $200B TAM; ARM collects royalties on every Vera CPU shipped. Bernstein PT $300; analysts project profits could rocket 5x by 2030. Next earnings expected August 5, 2026.
